meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 装上后,你把本地口播、访谈或播客视频交给 Claude,它会转录语音、设计一批按时间点出现的图形卡片(标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引用等),写好卡片 HTML 合成后渲染成 MP4,原片画面保持不变。
howto.when: 当你说「graphic overlays」「on-screen graphics」或要求给已有视频做图形包装时触发;纯字幕归 embedded-captions,意图不清先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 给这个口播视频加图形卡片包装,输出 9:16 竖版
say.note: 会先转录,再设计卡片并渲染 MP4

say.text: 把这段访谈做成带下三分之一和数据标注的 16:9 版本
say.note: 按转写内容排卡片时间点

say.text: 开头那句 5.69% 单独做一张全屏数字卡

howto.what_en: Hand Claude a local talking-head / interview / podcast clip: it transcribes the audio, designs timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, etc.), authors their HTML, and renders an MP4. The footage plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or to package / dress up an existing clip. Plain subtitles go to embedded-captions; unclear intent routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Package this talking-head clip with graphic cards and render it at 9:16.
Give this interview a 16:9 version with lower-thirds and data callouts.
say_en.note: Card timings come from the transcript

say_en.text: Make a fullscreen number card for the 5.69% line near the start.
say_en.note: You can point at one specific line
